newsitem.title: USA: New York Fed names Cecchetti director of research.
newsitem.headline: New York Fed names Cecchetti director of research.

text.p: The Federal Reserve Bank of New York said on Monday it had named Stephen Cecchetti, professor of economics at Ohio State University, as its new director of research, effective in August.
The New York Fed said Cecchetti will succeed Frederic Mishkin, who is leaving the New York Fed after three years as director of research.
Mishkin is returning in September to Columbia University's Graduate School of Business as a professor of economics.
The New York Fed said Cecchetti will join the bank as an executive vice president.

In addition to his teaching at Ohio State University, Cecchetti has been the editor of the "Journal of Money, Credit and Banking" since 1992, and has served as a consultant to several Federal Reserve Banks and other central banks, as well as to the Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System.
He has also been a consultant to the Federal Reserve Bank of Cleveland since 1991.
Cecchetti will continue as an economics professor at Ohio State University until he joins the New York Fed.
